name: sorp-processy
description: Process models for SORP: builds a runnable model of a map process once, derives and runs every test scenario, publishes open questions to the SORP stand, lets anyone with a stand key answer them in Claude or in the stand web form, and applies answers back incrementally. A completeness gate holds every fact of the map — step, desk, deadline, refusal, number, decision — either expressed in the model or listed as a deliberate skip with a reason. Role cards and virtual users turn desks into people, so scenarios also check who may do a step: adjacent desk, substitute, two desks in one pair of hands. Releases models to the simulation stand with UI tests. Code only — map data stays in your working folder.
